author.name: Dave deBronkart
author.headline: "e-Patient Dave" - Patient Empowerment evangelist. #PatientsUseAI. No pitches please.

comments.text:
This is just astounding.

We've already seen that people like Hugo Campos can achieve an order-of-magnitude extension of their powers using Claude Code to access their health data, accomplishing things despite having NO IDEA how to go about it.  Now we have freaking JOSH MANDEL achieving something that would have required an order-of-magnitude extension of his skill set into an area he's not like to have EVER found worth the time and effort.

We are experiencing the ongoing dawn of a new age - no, *continuously unrolling* new ages.

LOOK AT THE MANY WAYS HE WAS ABLE TO EXPLORE SOMETHING AUTONOMOUSLY, without being constrained by "What's the TAM for this ability?"

THIS is what #PatientUseAI users are finding in pursuing their individual medical needs, and here's Josh doing the exact same thing, philosophically.

New motto: "N of 1 is all we need, if our tools are powerful enough."
